for (const protectedIndex of [0, 1, 2]) {
  const a = [1, 2, 3, 4];
  Object.defineProperty(a, String(protectedIndex), { configurable: false });
  a.length = 0;
  console.log(a.length, a, Object.keys(a));
}
function strictShrink() {
  "use strict";
  const a = [1, 2, 3, 4];
  Object.defineProperty(a, "1", { get() { return 2; }, configurable: false });
  try { a.length = 0; } catch (e) { console.log(String(e)); }
  console.log(a.length, a, Object.keys(a));
}
strictShrink();
